mapper.select: select oj_note.user_id, oj_note.content, oj_note.business_type, oj_note.note_type, (IF(oj_note.business_type = 2, concat(oj_course_lesson.course_id, '/', oj_course_lesson.resource_id), oj_note.business_id)) as resource_id from oj_note left join oj_course_lesson on oj_note.business_id = oj_course_lesson.resource_id where oj_note.`user_id` = #{userId} and oj_note.note_type = #{noteType}

select (case when oj_course_lesson.resource_id is not null then concat(oj_course_lesson.course_id,'/',oj_course_lesson.resource_id) when oj_course.resource_id is not null then oj_course.resource_id when oj_practice_theory.resource_id is not null then oj_practice_theory.resource_id END) as resource_id, (case when oj_course.name is not null then oj_course.name when oj_course_lesson.name is not null then oj_course_lesson.name when oj_practice_theory.title is not null then oj_practice_theory.title when oj_practice_theory.content is not null then oj_practice_theory.content END) as name from oj_resource_collection left join oj_course on oj_resource_collection.business_id = oj_course.resource_id and oj_resource_collection.business_type = 3 left join oj_course_lesson on oj_resource_collection.business_id = oj_course_lesson.resource_id and oj_resource_collection.business_type = 4 left join oj_practice_theory on oj_resource_collection.business_id = oj_practice_theory.resource_id and oj_resource_collection.business_type = 0 where user_id = #{userId}
and business_type = #{businessType}

select count(distinct oj_course.resource_id) as course_count, SUM(oj_course_lesson.duration) as duration, SUM(case when oj_course_lesson.type = 0 then 1 END)as theory_count , SUM(case when oj_course_lesson.type = 1 then 1 END ) as exp_count from oj_lesson_record left join oj_course on oj_course.resource_id = oj_lesson_record.course_id left join oj_course_lesson on oj_course_lesson.resource_id = oj_lesson_record.lesson_id where oj_lesson_record.user_id = #{userId} and oj_course.public = true
select count(resource_id) from oj_note where note_type = 2 and user_id = #{userId}
select sum(score) as score, sum(resource_id) as report_count, row_number() over (order by score desc) as practice_ranking from oj_lesson_paper_evaluate where submit_user_id = #{userId}
